DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and digit.

The presentation of non-healing, crusty, rapidly changing lesions in a heavy smoker with a history of failed syphilis/eczema treatment is highly suggestive of cutaneous SCC.
